content:
Alex Chen: Hey team — just started at Redwood and my M1 Pro is stuck in Kandji enrollment loop. FileVault prompted but I don't see recovery key escrowed, and I can't sudo to install VPN. Wifi goes through corp captive portal which I can't authenticate during enrollment. Who should I ping?
IT Ops Bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/INC-4821 (assigned to IT-Ops).
Samir Patel: Welcome! Can you paste the exact Kandji error? Model and macOS version?
Alex Chen: macbookpro18,3  (M1 Pro) running macOS 13.5. Kandji shows "Enrollment failed: precheck error (network-auth)" then reboots to setup assistant and tries again.
Jordan Lee: Captive portals always kill MDM enroll. Can you join a non-captive network or tether phone? Ethernet works best.
Alex Chen: I tried tether — still loops. Here's the last bit of the console log during enroll: 
```
MDM: enrollment attempt failed: status 401, challenge: captive-portal
KandjiEnroll: preflight check failed: network restricted
fdesetup: FileVault is On for user alex
fdesetup: no recovery key escrowed
```
Marie Gomez: Oof. Looks like ABM assigned okay since it's reaching Kandji. Two things: 1) we can escrow the recovery key from our side, 2) we can create temporary admin so you can finish installs. DM me the serial and device ID.
Alex Chen: Serial: C02ABC123456, Device ID: 7f8e9d2c. DM'd you the full asset info.
Samir Patel: While Marie works that, can you run these (if you can get a terminal): 
```
sudo fdesetup status
profiles status -type enrollment
networksetup -getairportnetwork en0
```
Alex Chen: Ran them. Output:
```
$ sudo fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
$ profiles status -type enrollment
No enrolled MDM found
$ networksetup -getairportnetwork en0
You are connected to "Corp-Guest"
```
Jordan Lee: There we go — Corp-Guest is the captive one. You need Corp-WiFi or ethernet. If you can't get that, Kate can push a temporary profile that bypasses the portal for enrollment.
Kate Rivera: I can push an override. I'll escrow a recovery key and create a temp admin (expires in 24h). Pushing now, will DM when done.
IT Ops Bot: User alex added to "temp-admins" group (expires 24h).
Alex Chen: Sweet, thanks! Restarting now and will connect to phone hotspot during reboot.
Kate Rivera: Escrowed recovery key and pushed enrollment fix at 2112345786. Instructions DM'ed: reboot, connect to any network, let Kandji finish, then join Corp-WiFi. If it still loops, reply here and I'll escalate to devops-device-team. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: If Kandji still reports "No enrolled MDM found" after restart, run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and paste output.
Alex Chen: Back — enroll succeeded! FileVault shows escrowed now. Thanks all :partyparrot:
Marie Gomez: Welcome aboard and congrats on surviving first-day onboarding chaos :tada:
Jordan Lee: Ping eng-oncall if you notice app installs failing post-enroll.
Alex Chen: Will do. Thanks everyone!
